transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started on the Wednesday vehicle-dispatch desk roster. We've got three shifts to fill — day, swing, and night — plus one person in reserve. Our available personnel are SPC Hale, CPL Morris, SGT Ibarra, and PFC Cole. Before I finalize and sign anything, I want to hear from each of you on any considerations I should be aware of — qualifications, scheduling conflicts, anything from operations, motor pool, or battalion liaison that might affect how we assign these shifts. Who wants to start?
